formalized_ms: Asymptotically minimal maxima of real Littlewood polynomials
gap: Headline is two-sided ultraflatness (lower bound (1-ε)√N too); Lean gives only the max upper bound and L^p flatness; merit-factor corollary absent.
quote: The formalization gives real Littlewood polynomials of every sufficiently large length whose maximum modulus on the unit circle is at most $(1+\eta)\sqrt N$ for any fixed $\eta>0$.

formalized_ms: Polynomial Hitting Lists for Noncommutative Rational Formulas (also One Rational Matrix Hitting Point for Noncommutative Formulas)
gap: No positive-characteristic uniform tuple (O(n^3 s^6), poly(log p) time); char-0 point lacks its poly-time and O(ns^2) bounds.
quote: The paper's deterministic polynomial bit-construction bound and matrix-dimension bound $O(ns^2)$ are not separately asserted in it.

formalized_ms: A zero-entropy system without a smooth positive-volume model
gap: Lean asserts only finite Kolmogorov–Sinai entropy, not zero entropy.
quote: The linked statement gives finite entropy; the paper's stronger zero-entropy conclusion is outside this statement.

formalized_ms: Brownian continuum random tree limits of finite Fortuin–Kasteleyn maps above four
gap: Only the q>4 CRT regime; the q∈(0,4] LQG-sphere limits (surface side of the transition), random-walk and spectral results absent.
quote: For every fixed $q>4$, the formalization proves the Brownian continuum-random-tree limit for critical finite Fortuin–Kasteleyn planar maps.

formalized_ms: The exact reconstruction threshold for the three-state symmetric channel
gap: Only reconstruction above Kesten–Stigum for 3 states; nonreconstruction at/below threshold, the four-state Potts case and SBM corollary absent.
quote: The selected statements cover reconstruction above the Kesten–Stigum threshold. Non-reconstruction at or below the threshold and the stochastic-block-model consequences in the paper are outside them.

formalized_ms: Ground-state condensation in the dilute hard-sphere gas
gap: Lean is zero-temperature ground-state BEC; headline is condensation of the positive-temperature canonical Gibbs state (and depletion law).

formalized_ms: Bounded recovery for modular spectral averages
gap: Lean is the bounded spectral recovery tool; no amenable expected P⊂N with P'∩c(M)=N'∩c(M) (relative bicentralizer), nor absolute bicentralizer.

formalized_ms: Sharp integral fillings in CAT(0) spaces
gap: Lean is CAT(0) Euclidean filling bound plus coefficient optimality; κ<0 manifold isoperimetry for finite-perimeter sets and equality rigidity absent.
quote: This yields the selected integral-current form of the Cartan–Hadamard isoperimetric conjecture.

formalized_ms: Nonuniqueness for Bounded Measurable Scalar Conductivities in Three Dimensions
gap: Lean is the measurable-conductivity nonuniqueness counterexample; joint metric-plus-connection uniqueness from one boundary patch absent.
